news.title: Teens Are Turning to Chatbots for Mental Health Help. We Need Rules to Keep Them Safe
news.summary_en: With social media, product adoption raced ahead while Congress debated causation and passed no meaningful national protections for children. With AI chatbots, we still have a chance to build something sturdier.

news.title: Insights from table-top exercises in Europe on AI safety and cyber misuse
news.summary_en: This report presents findings from table-top exercises with senior policymakers in Germany, the Netherlands, and France, identifying governance gaps and capability priorities for responding to AI-enabled cyberattack crises.
